description: Réseau Alterbase (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AlterBase (79) SEOLIS. logo AlterBasePublic network of charging stations in the Deux-Sèvres department for electric and hybrid vehicles. Coverage: AlterBase (79) SEOLIS. The portal shows the English title as "Alterbase Network (IRVE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AlterBase (79) SEOLIS. Its keywords include irve, vehicule-electrique, borne-de-recharge-electrique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
